verses.pali: กะถัญจะ อุปะริเมนะ ปะริยาเยนะ สีลัง สัมมะทักขาตัง ภะคะวะตา,
verses.pali_roman: Kathañca uparimena pariyāyena sīlaṃ sammadakkhātaṃ bhagavatā,
verses.english: And how was virtue well proclaimed by the Blessed One in the higher exposition?

verses.pali: อิธะ ภิกขุ สีละวา โหติ,
verses.pali_roman: Idha bhikkhu sīlavā hoti,
verses.english: Here a bhikkhu is virtuous,

verses.pali: ปาติโมกขะสังวะระสังวุโต วิหะระติ อาจาระโคจะระสัมปันโน.
verses.pali_roman: Pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno.
verses.english: he dwells restrained by the restraint of the Pāṭimokkha, perfect in conduct and resort.

verses.pali: อะณุมัตเตสุ วัชเชสุ ภะยะทัสสาวี สะมาทายะ สิกขะติ สิกขาปะเทสูติ.
verses.pali_roman: Aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesūti.
verses.english: Seeing danger in the slightest fault, he trains by undertaking the training rules.

verses.pali: เอวัง โข อุปะริเมนะ ปะริยาเยนะ สีลัง สัมมะทักขาตัง ภะคะวะตา.
verses.pali_roman: Evaṃ kho uparimena pariyāyena sīlaṃ sammadakkhātaṃ bhagavatā.
verses.english: Thus was virtue well proclaimed by the Blessed One in the higher exposition.

verses.pali: กะถัญจะ สะมาธิ สัมมะทักขาโต ภะคะวะตา,
verses.pali_roman: Kathañca samādhi sammadakkhāto bhagavatā,
verses.english: And how was concentration well proclaimed by the Blessed One?

verses.pali: เหฏฐิเมนะปิ ปะริยาเยนะ สะมาธิ สัมมะทักขาโต ภะคะวะตา,
verses.pali_roman: Heṭṭhimenapi pariyāyena samādhi sammadakkhāto bhagavatā,
verses.english: By the lower exposition too, concentration was well proclaimed by the Blessed One;

verses.pali: อุปะริเมนะปิ ปะริยาเยนะ สะมาธิ สัมมะทักขาโต ภะคะวะตา.
verses.pali_roman: Uparimenapi pariyāyena samādhi sammadakkhāto bhagavatā.
verses.english: and by the higher exposition too, concentration was well proclaimed by the Blessed One.

verses.pali: กะถัญจะ เหฏฐิเมนะ ปะริยาเยนะ สะมาธิ สัมมะทักขาโต ภะคะวะตา,
verses.pali_roman: Kathañca heṭṭhimena pariyāyena samādhi sammadakkhāto bhagavatā,
verses.english: And how was concentration well proclaimed by the Blessed One in the lower exposition?

verses.pali: อิธะ อะริยะสาวะโก โวสัคคารัมมะณัง กะริต์วา ละภะติ สะมาธิง ละภะติ จิตตัสเสกัคคะตันติ.
verses.pali_roman: Idha ariyasāvako vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ labhati cittassekaggatanti.
verses.english: Here a noble disciple, having made release his object, gains concentration, gains one-pointedness of mind.

verses.pali: เอวัง โข เหฏฐิเมนะ ปะริยาเยนะ สะมาธิ สัมมะทักขาโต ภะคะวะตา.
verses.pali_roman: Evaṃ kho heṭṭhimena pariyāyena samādhi sammadakkhāto bhagavatā.
verses.english: Thus was concentration well proclaimed by the Blessed One in the lower exposition.

verses.pali: กะถัญจะ อุปะริเมนะ ปะริยาเยนะ สะมาธิ สัมมะทักขาโต ภะคะวะตา.
verses.pali_roman: Kathañca uparimena pariyāyena samādhi sammadakkhāto bhagavatā.
verses.english: And how was concentration well proclaimed by the Blessed One in the higher exposition?

verses.pali: อิธะ ภิกขุ วิวิจเจวะ กาเมหิ วิวิจจะ อะกุสะเลหิ ธัมเมหิ,
verses.pali_roman: Idha bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi,
verses.english: Here a bhikkhu, quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states,

verses.pali: สะวิตักกัง สะวิจารัง วิเวกะชัมปีติสุขัง ปะฐะมัง ฌานัง อุปะสัมปัชชะ วิหะระต,
verses.pali_roman: Savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajampītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharata,
verses.english: enters upon and dwells in the first jhāna, with applied and sustained thought, and the rapture and pleasure born of seclusion;

verses.pali: วิตักกะวิจารานัง วูปะสะมา,
verses.pali_roman: Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā,
verses.english: with the stilling of applied and sustained thought,

verses.pali: อัชฌัตตัง สัมปะสาทะนัง เจตะโส เอโกทิภาวัง อะวิตักกัง อะวิจารัง,
verses.pali_roman: Ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ,
verses.english: with inner confidence and unification of mind, without applied and sustained thought,

verses.pali: สะมาธิชัมปีติสุขัง ทุติยัง ฌานัง อุปะสัมปัชชะ วิหะระติ,
verses.pali_roman: Samādhijampītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
verses.english: he enters upon and dwells in the second jhāna, with the rapture and pleasure born of concentration;

verses.pali: ปีติยา จะ วิราคา อุเปกขะโก จะ วิหะระติ สะโต จะ สัมปะชาโน,
verses.pali_roman: Pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno,
verses.english: with the fading away of rapture he dwells equanimous, mindful and clearly comprehending,

verses.pali: สุขัญจะ กาเยนะ ปะฏิสังเวเทติ,
verses.pali_roman: Sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti,
verses.english: and he feels pleasure with the body;

verses.pali: ยันตัง อะริยา อาจิกขันติ อุเปกขะโก สะติมา สุขะวิหารีติ,
verses.pali_roman: Yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti,
verses.english: of which the noble ones declare, 'He is equanimous, mindful, one who dwells in pleasure' —

verses.pali: ตะติยัง ฌานัง อุปะสัมปัชชะ วิหะระติ.
verses.pali_roman: Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: he enters upon and dwells in the third jhāna.

verses.pali: สุขัสสะ จะ ปะหานา ทุกขัสสะ จะ ปะหานา,
verses.pali_roman: Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā,
verses.english: With the abandoning of pleasure and of pain,

verses.pali: ปุพเพวะ โสมะนัสสะโทมะนัสสานัง อัตถังคะมา,
verses.pali_roman: Pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā,
verses.english: and with the earlier disappearance of joy and grief,

verses.pali: อะทุกขะมะสุขัง อุเปกขาสะติปาริสุทธิง,
verses.pali_roman: Adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ,
verses.english: he enters the state that is neither painful nor pleasant, with purity of mindfulness due to equanimity —

verses.pali: จะตุตถัง ฌานัง อุปะสัมปัชชะ วิหะระตีติ,
verses.pali_roman: Catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatīti,
verses.english: he enters upon and dwells in the fourth jhāna.

verses.pali: เอวัง โข อุปะริเมนะ ปะริยาเยนะ สะมาธิ สัมมะทักขาโต ภะคะวะตา.
verses.pali_roman: Evaṃ kho uparimena pariyāyena samādhi sammadakkhāto bhagavatā.
verses.english: Thus was concentration well proclaimed by the Blessed One in the higher exposition.

verses.pali: กะถัญจะ ปัญญา สัมมะทักขาตา ภะคะวะตา,
verses.pali_roman: Kathañca paññā sammadakkhātā bhagavatā,
verses.english: And how was wisdom well proclaimed by the Blessed One?

verses.pali: เหฏฐิเมนะปิ ปะริยาเยนะ ปัญญา สัมมะทักขาตา ภะคะวะตา,
verses.pali_roman: Heṭṭhimenapi pariyāyena paññā sammadakkhātā bhagavatā,
verses.english: By the lower exposition too, wisdom was well proclaimed by the Blessed One;

verses.pali: อุปะริเมนะปิ ปะริยาเยนะ ปัญญา สัมมะทักขาตา ภะคะวะตา.
verses.pali_roman: Uparimenapi pariyāyena paññā sammadakkhātā bhagavatā.
verses.english: and by the higher exposition too, wisdom was well proclaimed by the Blessed One.

verses.pali: กะถัญจะ เหฏฐิเมนะ ปะริยาเยนะ ปัญญา สัมมะทักขาตา ภะคะวะตา,
verses.pali_roman: Kathañca heṭṭhimena pariyāyena paññā sammadakkhātā bhagavatā,
verses.english: And how was wisdom well proclaimed by the Blessed One in the lower exposition?

vocabulary.pali: อุปะริมะ / เหฏฐิมะ
vocabulary.meaning: the higher and the lower exposition — the two levels at which this passage sets out each of the three trainings in turn

vocabulary.pali: อาจาระโคจะระสัมปันนะ
vocabulary.meaning: perfect in conduct and in resort — how one behaves, and where one goes and whom one keeps company with
of the size of an atom; the slightest. Used of the faults in which a bhikkhu is to see danger

vocabulary.pali: โวสัคคารัมมะณะ
vocabulary.meaning: having release as its object — what makes ordinary concentration the noble kind

vocabulary.pali: จิตตัสเสกัคคะตา
vocabulary.meaning: one-pointedness of mind; the definition of samādhi given in the lower exposition
meditative absorption. The higher exposition defines concentration by the four of them in sequence

vocabulary.pali: วิตักกะ / วิจาระ
vocabulary.meaning: applied and sustained thought — present in the first jhāna and stilled in the second

vocabulary.pali: อุเปกขาสะติปาริสุทธิ
vocabulary.meaning: purity of mindfulness due to equanimity, which is what the fourth jhāna is named by

checks.issue: THE WHOLE PAGE IS PROSE, and that was measured rather than assumed: there is NO empty column band anywhere between x 270 and x 1880, so no gutter and no verse block. Six indented paragraphs, each opening กะถัญจะ. Every group therefore carries para_layout 'prose' explicitly rather than relying on the chant's own setting, which is 'lines' — exactly the case where the default would have been wrong.
ปาติโมกขะสังวะระสังวุโต with ต, consistent with this chant on pages 72 and 73 and still differing from the ปาฏิโมกขัง with ฏ in the chant above it on page 72.

THIS PARAGRAPH OPENS WITH A FULL STOP WHERE ITS THREE SIBLINGS USE A COMMA. Verses 29, 37 and 58 all end their opening question ภะคะวะตา, with a comma and run straight on; verse 40 ends ภะคะวะตา. with a full stop. Read at 2.4x — the mark sits on the baseline with no tail. Reproduced as printed. The English gives all four as questions regardless, because that is what กะถัญจะ makes them.

วิหะระต WITH NO ิ, WHERE THE SAME WORD IS วิหะระติ THREE TIMES ELSEWHERE ON THIS PAGE. Checked at 3.5x on an isolated crop with clear paper above the line: there is no vowel mark over the final ต. Verses 45, 46 and 49 all print วิหะระติ plainly. Standard Pali is viharati. Reproduced exactly as printed and transliterated to match — viharata, not viharati — because the two chanted layers have to agree with each other. This is the single thing on this page most worth checking against the book: either the printer dropped the vowel or the ink did, and only the book can say.

สุขะวิหารีติ carries the quotative ติ, which closes the phrase the noble ones are quoted as declaring. The English marks it with quotation marks the book does not print — that is the English doing the work the ติ does in the Pali, not a mark reproduced from the page.

A WORD REJOINED ACROSS A LINE BREAK. The line ends ปุพเพวะ โสมะนัสสะ- with a hyphen and the next opens โทมะนัสสานัง, so the word is โสมะนัสสะโทมะนัสสานัง and the hyphen is dropped. The same happens at verse 36, where สัมมะทัก- / ขาโต rejoins as สัมมะทักขาโต.

Verses 41 to 53 are the standard four-jhāna formula, which appears in many published translations — this English was written from what is printed here rather than recalled from one of them, so it will not match any particular version word for word.
